01- Hoeven (1), Noord Brabant, 25-05-2002
Report from Bert Janssen and Robert Boerman

During our visit at the Hoeven (1) formation of 18-06-2002 we heard from another formation near Hoeven. This circle in wheat with a diameter of 14 meters was found at 25-05-2002, but was not reported before. Because of the bad wheather we couldn't investigate this circle but maybe we will do it later.
